subject: ela
intro: Pick the helpful visual or audio.

items.prompt:
Something the audience SEES in a presentation is a:
A) visual
B) audio
C) snack

Something the audience HEARS is:
A) a visual
B) audio
C) a chair

Presenting the layers of the rainforest, the BEST visual is:
A) a labeled diagram of the layers
B) a photo of a race car
C) a menu
items.answer: A) a labeled diagram of the layers

steps: Matches the topic. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) a labeled diagram of the layers

items.prompt:
For a presentation about bird calls, what helps the audience most?
A) An audio recording of the calls
B) A silent photo only
C) A blank page
items.answer: A) An audio recording of the calls

steps: Audio lets them hear. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) An audio recording of the calls

items.prompt:
A GOOD visual for a presentation should:
A) match the topic and help the audience understand
B) be about something else
C) be too small to see
items.answer: A) match the topic and help the audience understand

steps: On topic and clear. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) match the topic and help the audience understand

items.prompt:
To compare the heights of three mountains, the BEST visual is a:
A) bar graph
B) poem
C) joke

steps: Bar graphs compare amounts. Key is A.

items.prompt:
You present about the planets. Which set of media is BEST?
A) Photos of each planet, a diagram of their order, and a short narrated clip
B) A photo of your lunch
C) No media at all
items.answer: A) Photos of each planet, a diagram of their order, and a short narrated clip

steps: On topic and informative. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) Photos of each planet, a diagram of their order, and a short narrated clip

items.prompt:
A visual only helps the audience when it:
A) clearly matches the topic and can be seen
B) is unrelated
C) is hidden
items.answer: A) clearly matches the topic and can be seen

steps: Relevant and visible. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) clearly matches the topic and can be seen
